exposure: early diagnosis of cholestasis (<32-week gestational age)
late diagnosis of cholestasis (>= 32-week gestational age)
early diagnosis of severe cholestasis (peak total bile acids >= 40 mmol/L)
outcome: cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart tracing
cohort: The study participants were singleton, non-anomalous live gestations complicated by cholestasis from 2005-2019.
finding: Earlier diagnosis of cholestasis was associated with increased rates of spontaneous preterm birth, iatrogenic preterm birth, and NICU admission, independent of peak total bile acid levels.
